fresh_external_primary_findings.finding: The server consumes libmtmd output embeddings as a physical buffer before llama decode, so one-encode feature reuse remains physically plausible; this does not prove safe familiarity geometry.

Reported Qwen-VL fine-grained OCR degradation in llama-server while llama-cli on the same build remains correct despite identical visual-token count; this supports binding preprocessing/grid/position identity and mandating server-vs-cli differential rather than treating token count as spatial equivalence.
Measured mapping between embedding generations can preserve compatibility in some settings, supporting a falsifiable certificate candidate but not automatic compatibility.
VLM representations are not inherently reliable open-set recognizers; held-out OOD metrics remain mandatory.
